g.text: Stage build: Adafruit 1.2-inch 7-segment (HT16K33 I2C backpack), panel button, footswitch jack
Raspberry Pi 5 / Pi 4. Physical header pin numbers, BCM GPIO names. Power off before wiring. Source: hardware/SPEC.md §3.1, §3.3, §3.5
Wire colours: red 5 V · orange 3.3 V · black GND · blue I2C SDA · yellow I2C SCL · green panel button (GPIO17) · white footswitch (GPIO27)
Footswitch: R1 1 kΩ in series, C1 100 nF from the GPIO27 side of R1 to GND, both soldered at the jack. Dashed line = component lead soldered directly, no wire.

g.title: PI
g.text: Only the pins used by this build are shown.

g.title: W2
g.text: Dupont jumper F-F, far housing cut off
Female housing on the Pi. Button end: strip 5 mm,
solder to the lug under 4.8 mm heat-shrink, or clamp in the screw terminal.

g.title: W3
g.text: Dupont jumper F-F, far housing cut off
Female housing on the Pi. Trim to about 15 cm.
White: ends in the splice with R1 and C1 (3.2 mm heat-shrink).
Black: SLEEVE lug, shared with C1 (4.8 mm heat-shrink).

g.title: HT16K33
g.text: IO sets the I2C pull-up voltage: 3.3 V only, never 5 V.
Wire by the labels printed on the backpack.

g.title: BUTTON
g.text: Panel button, 16 mm momentary, normally open
2-lug switch - either way round. 3-lug switch - use C and NO, leave NC free.

g.title: R1
g.text: other lead into the TIP lug

g.title: C1
g.text: other lead into the SLEEVE lug

g.title: JACK
g.text: 1/4-inch (6.35 mm) mono TS jack, open frame
Any momentary pedal (e.g. Boss FS-5U, sustain pedal).
Extra switch lug, if present: leave free.
